# Niagova

> Niagova builds websites, booking systems, online ordering and business applications for small and medium businesses in Malaysia. Formerly MyBizGate. Tagline: Built for Business. Ready for Growth.

## What we do
- Business websites for Malaysian SMEs (mobile-first, WhatsApp-integrated, Google Business Profile setup)
- Booking and appointment systems with live availability and WhatsApp confirmation
- Online catalogues, ordering and shopping-cart flows with pickup or delivery
- Admin dashboards and web applications for bookings, orders, customers and staff
- Custom systems: quotation wizards, calculators, job tracking, integrations

## Who we build for
Spas and salons, dental and medical clinics, pet hotels, car detailing, home services, solar installers, contractors, retail and wholesale, homestays, cafés, tuition centres and other Malaysian SMEs.

## How it works
Free consultation, a working demo tailored to the business within 48 hours, setup paid only after the demo is approved, then a yearly plan for hosting, maintenance and support.

## Pricing (Malaysian Ringgit)
- Starter Website: RM 299 one-time setup + RM 199 per year
- Business Website: RM 599 one-time setup + RM 299 per year
- Website + System: RM 999 one-time setup + RM 399 per year
- Custom Build: quoted after a free call
